lines.zh: 我踩着恶地的红砂石走
lines.en: I walk over the badlands' red sandstone

lines.zh: 背上有块隆起，比别处高
lines.en: There is a ridge on my back, higher than the rest
I do not walk fast, but my strides are long

lines.zh: 砂石松，一脚下去滑一段
lines.en: The scree is loose, each step slides a bit
My kin and I keep a few steps apart
The wind carries red dust, I narrow my eyes

lines.zh: 我的爪子在石头上刮出白痕
lines.en: My claws leave white marks on the stone

lines.zh: 我看一眼地平线，再往前走
lines.en: I check the horizon and walk on
The ridge on my back is warm in the sun
I slow my pace to wait for the others

lines.zh: 恶地的沟很深，我沿着边走
lines.en: The gullies are deep, I walk the rims
I lift a leg over a crack

lines.zh: 我和同伴保持一个身位
lines.en: I keep one body-length from my kin

lines.zh: 我抬脚试了试石头，再落下去
lines.en: I test the stone with a foot before setting it down

lines.zh: 我站在岩柱的影子下面
lines.en: I stand in the shadow of a rock pillar
I open my mouth to shed heat

lines.zh: 风打在隆起上，我转了个角度
lines.en: Wind hits the ridge, I turn an angle

lines.zh: 同族散在四周，各自站着
lines.en: My kin are spread around, each standing alone
There is a little sound in my throat

lines.zh: 我看得很远，这里没有遮挡
lines.en: I can see far, there is no cover here
I tuck my claws under me
Red clay sticks between my toes
I lower my head and sniff the stone
In this season the wind never stops

lines.zh: 我眯着眼，等太阳低一点
lines.en: I squint, waiting for the sun to drop

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一块红石
lines.en: I hold still, like a red stone

lines.zh: 我伸出舌头，舔了舔鼻子
lines.en: I flick my tongue over my snout
The wind below the slope is warmer

lines.zh: 你站在下风口，我闻到了
lines.en: You stand downwind, I smelled you
I raise my head, a head above you

lines.zh: 你身上没有这里的红土
lines.en: There is none of this red clay on you
I do not often see people in this stretch
I open my mouth, all my teeth showing

lines.zh: 我往前走了一步，你又退了一步
lines.en: I take one step, and you take one back
This badland is mine
I tilt my head and look a long while

lines.zh: 你的靴子撑不住这里的石头
lines.en: Your boots will not last on this stone

lines.zh: 我背上的隆起，你注意到了吗
lines.en: Did you notice the ridge on my back
I growl, low
The hide is split, not deep
I pulled half a step in and held
That one went between the ribs
You were a step quicker than me
Blood on red clay cannot be seen
Blood drips on red earth and does not show.
I only grunt
What you hold is meat

lines.zh: 我的手离你的手只有一步
lines.en: My hand is one step from yours
That will not even line my teeth
Lower it, I can reach
I am in no hurry, I can wait
Your hand shook, I noticed

lines.zh: 这个味道，让我想起了什么
lines.en: That smell reminds me of something
I bite low, not your hand
I have finished what you offered

lines.zh: 你撞在我胸侧，我退了一步
lines.en: You hit my flank and I took one step back
My ridge nearly struck you
That one, I heard a bone

lines.zh: 别贴着我，我转身不留余地
lines.en: Do not press close, I do not leave room when I turn
I swept my tail at you

lines.zh: 你退了，砂石在你脚下滑
lines.en: You backed off, and the scree slid underfoot

lines.zh: 我站住没动，你也没推动
lines.en: I stood and you moved nothing

lines.zh: 这一碰，你的骨头出声了
lines.en: At that contact, your bones spoke

lines.zh: 这一碰，我记住了你的味道
lines.en: That gave me your scent
I gave half a step, that is my courtesy

lines.zh: 恶地上的同类，各走各的
lines.en: My kind here keep their own company
There is red ground enough to share

lines.zh: 我背上的隆起，是给别人看的
lines.en: The ridge on my back is meant to be seen

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，我转身会撞到你
lines.en: You are too close, I would hit you turning

lines.zh: 我先看看你跑得怎么样
lines.en: Let me see how you run first
The season does not suit
I will walk over slowly and look again
Prints show clearly on this scree
I will walk a stretch with you
I lower my head and take it in my teeth
It is very small in my mouth
I bite it, quite hard

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，全是石头味。
lines.en: I bite it; it tastes only of stone.
I spat it onto the rock
It went rolling down the slope

lines.zh: 恶地的我，背上有两片鳍。
lines.en: In the badlands, two fins rise from my back.
I will remember this smell
The owner of this will come looking
I will carry it back for the others

lines.zh: 恶地的热风，把血味吹给我。
lines.en: The badlands heat carries the smell of blood to me.
I raise my head, my neck straight

lines.zh: 你站在坡下，正好在我视线里
lines.en: You stand below the slope, right in my sight
There is no cover in the badlands

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，同伴也跟着叫
lines.en: I called, and my kin answered

lines.zh: 这块地是我打猎的地方
lines.en: This ground is where I hunt
You are retreating now, that is too late
I open my mouth and heat pours out
My feet settle on the scree

lines.zh: 你的影子在红土上很清楚
lines.en: Your shadow is plain on the red clay

lines.zh: 我们的距离，还有二十步
lines.en: Twenty paces left between us
I lower my body and run
My kin have gone around the other side

lines.zh: 我沿着坡线咬住你不放
lines.en: I hold you along the ridgeline
You go around the rocks, I take the gully

lines.zh: 恶地的沟会把你绕回来
lines.en: The gullies here will turn you back
I can run longer than you

lines.zh: 我背上的隆起在阳光下很亮
lines.en: The ridge on my back is bright in the sun
Your breathing is heavier now

lines.zh: 这片红土我走了好几年
lines.en: I have walked this red ground for years
I reached the ridge first
The scree is too loose, you cannot run
I have not called once
Ahead of you is a drop

lines.zh: 我把爪子收起来，跑得更快
lines.en: I draw in my claws and run faster

lines.zh: 你的脚踝一直在找平稳的地
lines.en: Your ankles keep searching for footing
I am less than ten steps away

lines.zh: 这两侧的坡，正好夹住你
lines.en: These two slopes will close you in

lines.zh: 我撞过去，把你推在石上
lines.en: I charge and slam you into the stone
My claws rake your back
That took your footing

lines.zh: 我脖子一拧，你失了重心
lines.en: One twist of my neck and you lost balance
My jaws close hard
You retreat, and I follow up
That hurt my claws too
I pin you with my whole weight

lines.zh: 挡得了一次，挡不了第二次
lines.en: Once you block, not twice
There is a growl in my throat

lines.zh: 这一下不深，可够你走不动
lines.en: Not deep, but enough to stop you walking
My kin are coming in from the side
Your armor stopped half of it
That one should make you shout

lines.zh: 红土上，一个影子立住了
lines.en: On the red clay, a shadow has taken its stand
I walk out from behind a pillar
The ridge on my back shows first

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，砂石滑了一片
lines.en: The scree slid when I landed

lines.zh: 风把我身上的红土吹起来
lines.en: The wind lifts the red dust off me

lines.zh: 我和同族一起站在坡上
lines.en: My kin and I stand on the slope

lines.zh: 地上多了几串三趾的印
lines.en: Several three-toed prints on the ground
I open my mouth and pant a few times
Nobody has been through this stretch
I climb up out of the gully

lines.zh: 我的影子拖在红土上很长
lines.en: My shadow stretches long on the red clay
A call in the distance, one of my kind

lines.zh: 红砂上多了一串新的爪印
lines.en: A fresh line of claw prints on the red sand
I come down from upwind
The sound of the wind here has changed
My throat sounded first

lines.zh: 火烧到我的背，那块隆起最烫
lines.en: Fire caught my back, the ridge burned worst

lines.zh: 我摔进沟里，砂石跟着下来
lines.en: I fell into the gully, scree following
The water is too murky, I cannot see bottom
The blast left me unsteady on the sliding stone

lines.zh: 一支箭插进我背上的隆起
lines.en: An arrow stands in the ridge on my back
That cold walked all the way to my feet

lines.zh: 恶地上没有猎物，我饿得发虚
lines.en: No prey in the badlands, hunger hollows me

lines.zh: 雷落在岩柱上，我半边身子麻了
lines.en: Lightning struck the pillar and half of me went numb
No ground here, my feet find nothing
